conceptual assets.concept: JTAG TAP instruction register value that selects which data register is accessed
conceptual assets.reasoning: reg_access stores and updates the IR and uses it to route DR operations: on LOGIC_RESET/IR_CAPTURE `tap_reg.ireg <= addr_idcode_c`; in IR_SHIFT with TCK rising `tap_reg.ireg <= tap_sync.tdi & tap_reg.ireg(...)`; reg_access then uses `case tap_reg.ireg is` to choose idcode, dtmcs or dmi for DR_CAPTURE/DR_SHIFT and the IR is driven out on TDO in IR_SHIFT (`jtag_tdo_o <= tap_reg.ireg(0)`). Corrupting this value causes wrong DR access, so integrity is required for correct DR selection.

conceptual assets.concept: TAP controller FSM state (current TAP phase)
conceptual assets.reasoning: tap_control updates the TAP state on JTAG TCK edges and TMS: `if (tap_sync.tck_rising='1') then case tap_ctrl_state is ...` and other processes (reg_access, update_trigger) test specific states such as DR_CAPTURE, DR_SHIFT and DR_UPDATE. Integrity of tap_ctrl_state is required so TAP sequencing and register-capture/shift/update behaviors follow the implemented state transitions.

conceptual assets.concept: DR_UPDATE event pulse that gates register-update and DMI actions
conceptual assets.reasoning: update_trigger sets `dr_trigger.sreg` when `tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE` and `dr_trigger.valid` is computed as `'1' when (dr_trigger.sreg = "01") else '0'`. dmi_controller and register-update logic test this pulse (e.g. `if (dr_trigger.valid='1') and (tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c) then dmi_ctrl.dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16);` and similar uses to start/qualify DMI ops). The pulse therefore gates DMI and update flows; its integrity is required to avoid spurious or missed updates.

conceptual assets.concept: IDCODE register value returned by the IDCODE DR
conceptual assets.reasoning: On DR_CAPTURE when the IR selects IDCODE (`when addr_idcode_c`) the RTL sets `tap_reg.idcode <= IDCODE_VERSION & IDCODE_PARTID & IDCODE_MANID & '1'`; in DR_SHIFT idcode is shifted; readout is produced on TDO (`jtag_tdo_o <= tap_reg.idcode(0)`). Integrity of tap_reg.idcode is required so the value reported over TDO matches the implemented IDCODE assembly.

conceptual assets.concept: DTM Control/Status register (DTMCS) value used to control DMI resets and status
conceptual assets.reasoning: tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt is assembled from controller state (`tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(17) <= dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset; tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(16) <= dmi_ctrl.dmireset;` etc.), DR_CAPTURE copies `tap_reg.dtmcs <= tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt`, and dmi_controller applies DTMCS on update (`if (dr_trigger.valid='1') and (tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c) then dmi_ctrl.dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16); dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(17);`). Therefore the DTMCS value implements DMI reset/control and its integrity is required for correct reset semantics.

conceptual assets.concept: DMI data/command register content carried between JTAG and the DMI (addr, wdata, op, err fields)
conceptual assets.reasoning: tap_reg.dmi_nxt is formed from controller state (`tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err,2)`), DR_CAPTURE writes `tap_reg.dmi <= tap_reg.dmi_nxt`, and in dmi_controller a DR_UPDATE when IR=DTM_DMI causes `dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34); dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02); if tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0)=... then dmi_ctrl.op <= tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0);`. DR_SHIFT shifts tap_reg.dmi from TDI and its bits are driven out on TDO. The register therefore carries DMI commands/data between JTAG and the DMI; its integrity is required to ensure the intended DMI operations.

conceptual assets.concept: Outgoing DMI request state issued to the external DMI (op, addr, wdata and busy)
conceptual assets.reasoning: dmi_controller constructs requests by loading `dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34); dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02); dmi_ctrl.op <= tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0); dmi_ctrl.busy <= '1'` when starting an operation, and the module drives the external request signals from these fields (`dmi_req_o.op <= dmi_ctrl.op; dmi_req_o.data <= dmi_ctrl.wdata; dmi_req_o.addr <= dmi_ctrl.addr;`). Integrity of these controller fields is required so the external DMI receives the intended request and arbitration (busy) state.

conceptual assets.concept: DMI response data and error state captured from the external DMI and returned to JTAG
conceptual assets.reasoning: When a request is outstanding the controller captures the response (`dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data; if (dmi_rsp_i.ack='1') then dmi_ctrl.busy <= '0';`). dmi_ctrl.err is set on competing update (`elsif (dmi_ctrl.busy='1') and (dr_trigger.valid='1') and (tap_reg.ireg = addr_dmi_c) then dmi_ctrl.err <= '1'`) and cleared on resets. Readback to JTAG is composed from these fields (`tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err,2)`). Integrity of rdata/err is required so read responses presented to JTAG reflect the implemented DMI response status and data.
